import math
import unittest

from solution import attach_entries


class AttachEntriesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_attachment_order_copying_and_empty_accounts(self):
        accounts = [{"id": 2, "name": "two"}, {"id": 1, "name": "one"}]
        entries = [
            {"account_id": 1, "amount": 2},
            {"account_id": 2, "amount": 3.5},
            {"account_id": 1, "amount": -4},
        ]
        result = attach_entries(iter(accounts), iter(entries))
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"id": 2, "name": "two", "entries": [{"account_id": 2, "amount": 3.5}]},
            {"id": 1, "name": "one", "entries": [
                {"account_id": 1, "amount": 2.0},
                {"account_id": 1, "amount": -4.0},
            ]},
        ])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["entries"], result[1]["entries"])
        result[1]["entries"][0]["amount"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]["amount"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["entries"][1]["amount"], -4.0)
        self.assertEqual(attach_entries([], []), [])

    def test_container_and_field_type_errors(self):
        for accounts, entries in ((None, []), ([], None), ("x", []), ([], b"x")):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError): attach_entries(accounts, entries)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): attach_entries([[]], [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): attach_entries([{"id": True, "name": "x"}], [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": 2}], [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "x"}], [{"account_id": 1, "amount": True}])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "x"}], [{"account_id": "1", "amount": 2}])

    def test_structural_and_value_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "x", "extra": 1}], [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 0, "name": "x"}], [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": ""}], [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "a"}, {"id": 1, "name": "b"}], [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([], [{"account_id": 1, "amount": 2}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "a"}], [{"account_id": 2, "amount": 2}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "a"}], [{"account_id": 1, "amount": math.nan}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): attach_entries([{"id": 1, "name": "a"}], [{"account_id": 1, "amount": 2, "extra": 3}])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
